Three Sisters Bungalow by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 In the heart of historic Old Seagrove, right on 30A, welcome to Three Sisters Bungalow! This charming home has plenty of curb appeal, with a cozy, neighborhood vibe. The many amenities include a golf cart and 3 complimentary bikes, making it easy to explore the area. The Scenic 395 Beach Access is only a few hundred steps away! Oh, and it’s pet-friendly. Hop on your bike for a quick ride through Old Seagrove and check out some of the best local spots.

Surfing Deer, Seagrove Village Market, Café Thirty-A, and The Perfect Pig are all nearby, offering amazing eats right around the corner. This single-story luxury home sits on a large lot with plenty of parking, making it ideal for larger families. But check out these interiors! The spacious open living area is perfect for relaxing and streaming your favorite shows on the large TV. And that wonderful kitchen! Also gorgeous and inviting, and fully equipped to handle big family meals and special snacks for the beach. A large laundry room and a shared hall bathroom are down the hall next to the first primary bedroom and guest bedroom. On the other side of the house, the second primary bedroom offers a dreamy couple’s retreat with a king bed, a large ensuite bathroom, a walk-in closet, and French doors leading to the front deck. Bring the whole family, (and pooch!) and enjoy the sunshine, great food, and unforgettable memories at Three Sisters Bungalow! Overview: - 434 steps (.2 miles) to the beach (Scenic 395 Access) - 3 bedroom, 2 bath - 1560 sq ft - Golf Cart - Dogs considered, an additional $210 nonrefundable fee for each dog - Gas grill - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Parking limited to 4 vehicles with no street parking Overnight: - King in primary bedroom; tub; shower; TV - King in guest room; shared hall bath; tub/shower combo; TV) - Full in guest room; shared hall bath; tub/shower comb - Twin daybed in lounge room Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
